scope: Previously completed read-only independent raw-rank recomputation; this receipt performs no model, GPU, training, numerical test or tolerance assertion.

source_mapping_review.dtype_scope: The saved values dtype is categorical read_outcomes log-probability dtype, not an assertion about every intermediate operator dtype.

matched_ids_cross_layout_caution.comparison: Original selected literal IDs: new native-reader factual/full-EOS/single-delete B4 variant layout versus previous paired attribute batches.
matched_ids_cross_layout_caution.conclusion: These pre-existing endpoint differences are non-negligible relative to the sampled single-delete effects. The paired token discrepancy alone does not isolate all error or attenuation to the DT decomposition.

report_wording_review.categorical_log_probability_dtype: Complete dtype set is reported; no silent set.pop selection.
report_wording_review.case_timing: 64 case timers cover 66 native forwards because the first case on each rank includes one same-input repetition; not 64 individual forward durations.
report_wording_review.pooled_target_log_ratio: Observed-class mixture: success-class target for successful rows and failure-class target for failed rows.

limitations: One checkpoint and eight original prompt groups; 64 trajectories are not 64 independent tasks.
Two token positions per successful trajectory are dependent samples, selected uniformly with the fixed seed rather than by credit magnitude.
Native single deletion is the same model counterfactual, not a true-world environment oracle.
Practical readout calibration is separate from the accepted exact-token-value premise.
G0 fixed-formula advantages remain zero; this probe did not measure failed-trajectory DT d.
Saved d was diagnostically inverted from saved FP32 A rather than measured anew by a finite trace.
Batch-fitted constant Brier is descriptive and is not an out-of-sample predictive baseline.
Same-input repetition and cross-layout differences are descriptive observations, not new whole-network tolerances or official FA/FLA numerical acceptance.
No production, Q/V/A formula, optimizer, entropy setting or training configuration changed.
